questions.enonce_markdown:
(a) Give TWO effects of increasing the resolution or the number of pixels of a digital camera. (2 marks)

(b) What is automatic input devices and give two examples. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(a) Two effects of increasing the resolution (number of pixels) of a digital camera (2 marks)**

- The pictures have **more detail and better quality** (they are sharper and can be enlarged or printed in a bigger size without becoming blurred).
- Each picture has a **larger file size**, so it uses **more storage space** on the memory card (fewer pictures can be stored) and takes longer to save, transfer or send. (The camera also costs more.)

**(b) Automatic input devices (2 marks)**

Automatic input devices are devices that **capture data and enter them into the computer directly, with no or very little typing by a person**, which makes the data entry faster and more accurate. Examples: a **barcode reader** (scanner) and an **RFID reader**. (Others: optical mark reader, magnetic stripe reader, optical character reader, sensors.)

questions.enonce_markdown:
To send documents, companies sometimes use emails or post office.

(a) Give two advantages of using e-mails over post office. (2 marks)

(b) Give two reasons why post office might be preferable. (2 marks)

(c) Brandon has just bought a laptop computer. Give TWO requirements needed to enable him send and receive e-mails using the laptop. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(a) Two advantages of e-mail over the post office (2 marks)**

- E-mail is **much faster**: a message and its attached documents arrive in seconds, wherever the receiver is.
- E-mail is **cheaper and more convenient**: there are no stamps, paper or travelling, the same message can be sent to many people at once, and the messages can be stored and searched on the computer.

**(b) Two reasons why the post office might be preferable (2 marks)**

- **Physical items and original signed documents** (parcels, certificates, legal documents) can be sent by post but not by e-mail.
- The post office can be used by people **without a computer or an Internet connection** (for example in remote areas), and it is not affected by **power cuts, viruses, spam or hacking**.

**(c) Two requirements for Brandon (2 marks)**

- An **Internet connection**: a subscription with an Internet service provider (ISP), using a modem, a Wi-Fi network or mobile data.
- An **e-mail account (e-mail address)** with an **e-mail program or a web browser** to read, write and send the messages.
